input_path.description: Explicit repository-root target_path supplied by the assignment/invocation.

resolved_input_path.description: Canonical absolute real path; must equal target.git_root after controlled Git root discovery.

items.description: Canonical absolute object store path, including discovered alternates.

harness_git_root.description: Canonical absolute harness Git worktree root.

harness_git_common_dir.description: Canonical absolute harness Git common directory.

items.description: Canonical absolute harness object store, including discovered alternates.

execution_policy.description: One workspace-scoped execution policy established at initialization and reused through internal stages and recovery.

items.description: Canonical absolute real paths strictly beneath or equal to target.git_root.
Legacy path-scope bookkeeping only; workspace writes are bound by execution_policy.

Normalized repository-relative product source/test/config/documentation and source-requirement/approved-decision paths whose exact contents form the immutable verification revision; excludes mutable workflow records and evidence.

blocked_by_decision.description: Independent increments may run while a plan decision remains open.

worktree_metadata.description: Non-content fingerprint for protected sensitive paths; avoids reading secret bytes.

review_assignments.description: Expected read-only reviews assigned before review starts; the gate checks the risk-required roster against these assignments and their reports.

invocation_attempted_at.description: Persisted one-shot claim written atomically immediately before the external invocation.

review_manifest_sha256.description: Deterministic authorized-input manifest bound to target, workflow, revision, review assignment and round.

claude_review_cycles.description: Target-local Claude review history. round_count counts only valid schema-compliant completed reports. Failed or rejected attempts remain recorded and do not count; one explicit recovery transition may authorize a second attempt for that reserved round. A workflow-state scan prevents resetting review history. At most two completed rounds and one Claude cycle per target increment are allowed.

items.description: Canonical absolute directories; target root is required and ancestors need explicit authorization.

authorizer_identity_assurance.description: Declared is appropriate when explicit user task authorization is the available provenance and the runtime cannot establish authenticated identity.

authorizer_session_identity.description: Session attribution from the current runtime when available; null means the runtime exposes no session identity.

operation_effects.description: Prohibits remote mutation and explicitly acknowledges that the external review may incur cost, with a human-approved limit. The adapter cannot enforce a provider-side monetary ceiling.

expires_or_revocation.description: Required compatibility field from the frozen authorization policy; expires_at and revoked provide machine-checkable enforcement.

authorization_verifier.description: Workflow owner attribution used to bind authorization verification to its actual source. Declared identity is an attestation, not authentication or an identity provider.

approved_revision_id.description: Immutable content identity approved by the referenced gate.

commit_sha.description: Optional commit provenance; it does not replace approved_revision_id.

commit_equivalence_reference.description: Record showing the committed revision_paths manifest equals approved_revision_id.
